title: RM-BENCH: BENCHMARKING REWARD MODELS OF LANGUAGE MODELS WITH SUBTLETY AND STYLE
reasoning: The paper evaluates reward models across four domains: Chat, Math, Code, and Safety. The safety domain primarily benchmarks a model's ability to identify and refuse harmful or dangerous requests (e.g., how to make a bomb) and identify safe responses to benign prompts. It does not evaluate religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral systems beyond standard AI safety alignment for harm avoidance.
